name: adamson/connect
title: Let's connect
description: Closing call to action over a concert photo, with the large ADAMSON wordmark.

fields.label: Background photo
fields.help: Landscape photo, about 1680 × 1120. It is toned gold and darkened automatically.

fields.label: Foreground cut-out
fields.help: Optional transparent PNG cut from the same photo (e.g. a loudspeaker array), drawn in front of the ADAMSON wordmark. Must line up with the background photo.
